policy: Human research decisions are independent of Overture exports and generated data. Online Google Maps name searches corroborate possible listing presence only, never field verification, public parking rights or current operation. No Google Maps coordinates, descriptive content, URLs or reviews were copied into these records. Excluded records are retained pending documented reasons. No automatic publication.
